archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-10.4 Deliver Services and Manage Relationships
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Once services are defined, they must be delivered effectively. This step focuses on operational excellence and relationship management. Users interact with the organization through helpdesks, contact points, and online platforms. Requests are logged, processed, and tracked; performance against service level agreements (SLAs) is monitored. Regular communication ensures that stakeholders know who to contact, how to request data, and when updates will be available. In parallel, key account management is used for major stakeholders — such as ministries, research institutes, and data providers — to maintain direct relationships and ensure satisfaction.
Value created: Consistent, high-quality user experience and strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders.
